questions.stem: If 4<var>x</var> − 9 = 23, what is the value of <var>x</var>?
questions.explain: Add 9 to both sides: 4x = 32. Divide by 4: x = 8.

questions.stem: Pencils come in packs of 12. Mia buys 7 packs and uses 30 pencils during the semester. How many pencils does she have left?
What is the <var>y</var>-intercept of the graph of <var>y</var> = 3<var>x</var> − 5 in the <var>xy</var>-plane?
questions.explain: The y-intercept is where x = 0: y = 3(0) − 5 = −5, so the point is (0, −5). Choice C is the x-intercept.
questions.calc: Type y = 3x − 5 and tap where the line crosses the y-axis.

questions.stem: 40 is what percent of 160?
questions.explain: 40 ÷ 160 = 0.25, which is 25%. Choice D comes from dividing 160 by 40.

questions.stem: The function <var>f</var> is defined by <var>f</var>(<var>x</var>) = <var>x</var><sup>2</sup> − 3<var>x</var> + 2. What is the value of <var>f</var>(4)?
questions.calc: Define f(x) = x^2 − 3x + 2 on one line, then type f(4) on the next.

questions.stem: A right triangle has legs of length 6 and 8. What is the length of its hypotenuse?
questions.explain: 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100, and √100 = 10. Choice C adds the legs, which isn't how hypotenuses work.

questions.stem: x + y = 10x − y = 4If (x, y) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of x?
questions.explain: Add the equations: 2x = 14, so x = 7. Choice A is y.
questions.calc: Graph both lines and tap their intersection: (7, 3).

questions.stem: What is the mean of the data set 4, 8, 10, 14, 19?
questions.explain: The sum is 55 and there are 5 values. 55 ÷ 5 = 11.

questions.stem: Which expression is equivalent to (<var>x</var> + 3)<sup>2</sup>?
questions.explain: (x + 3)(x + 3) = x² + 3x + 3x + 9 = x² + 6x + 9. Choice A forgets the middle term.
questions.calc: Graph (x + 3)^2 and each choice. Only C lands exactly on top of it.

questions.stem: A phone plan costs $25 per month plus $0.10 for each text message sent. Which equation gives the monthly cost <var>C</var>, in dollars, for sending <var>t</var> text messages?
questions.explain: Each text adds $0.10, so 0.10t, plus the fixed $25. Choice A swaps the rate and the fixed fee.

questions.stem: A circle has an area of 49π square inches. What is the radius of the circle, in inches?
questions.explain: A = πr², so r² = 49 and r = 7.

questions.stem: What is the positive solution to the equation <var>x</var><sup>2</sup> − 5<var>x</var> − 14 = 0?
questions.explain: Factor: (x − 7)(x + 2) = 0, so x = 7 or x = −2. The positive solution is 7.
questions.calc: Graph y = x^2 − 5x − 14 and tap the x-intercepts.

questions.stem: A bag holds 5 red marbles, 3 blue marbles and 2 green marbles. One marble is chosen at random. What is the probability that it is blue?
questions.explain: There are 10 marbles and 3 are blue, so the probability is 3/10. Choice B compares blue to the non-blue marbles.

questions.stem: Which inequality describes all solutions to 3(2 − <var>x</var>) > 12?
questions.explain: 6 − 3x > 12, so −3x > 6. Dividing by a negative flips the sign: x < −2.

questions.stem: A town has a population of 8,000 that grows by 5% each year. Which function gives the population <var>P</var> after <var>t</var> years?
questions.explain: Growing by 5% means multiplying by 1 + 0.05 = 1.05 each year. Choice B would shrink the population.

questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, angle C is the right angle and sin A = 35. What is cos A?
questions.explain: Opposite = 3 and hypotenuse = 5, so the adjacent side is 4 (a 3-4-5 triangle). cos A = adjacent ÷ hypotenuse = 4/5.

questions.stem: The graphs of <var>y</var> = <var>x</var><sup>2</sup> − 4 and <var>y</var> = 2<var>x</var> − 1 intersect at two points in the <var>xy</var>-plane. What is the sum of the <var>x</var>-coordinates of the two points?
questions.explain: Set them equal: x² − 4 = 2x − 1, so x² − 2x − 3 = 0 and (x − 3)(x + 1) = 0. The x-coordinates are 3 and −1, which sum to 2.
questions.calc: Graph both equations and tap each intersection: (−1, −3) and (3, 5).

questions.stem: For a group of students, the line of best fit for test score <var>y</var> versus hours studied <var>x</var> is <var>y</var> = 2.4<var>x</var> + 31. Based on this line, what is the predicted score for a student who studied 10 hours?
The graph of <var>f</var>(<var>x</var>) = 2<sup><var>x</var></sup> + <var>k</var>, where <var>k</var> is a constant, passes through the point (3, 11). What is the value of <var>k</var>?
questions.calc: Graph y = 2^x + k with a slider for k and the point (3, 11). Slide k until the curve hits the point.

questions.stem: Triangle P is similar to triangle Q. Each side of triangle Q is 52 times as long as the corresponding side of triangle P. If the area of triangle P is 12, what is the area of triangle Q?
questions.explain: Areas scale by the square of the side ratio: (5/2)² = 25/4. 12 × 25/4 = 75. Choice A scales by 5/2 only once.

questions.stem: What is the minimum value of <var>y</var> = <var>x</var><sup>2</sup> − 8<var>x</var> + 21?
questions.explain: The vertex is at x = 8 ÷ 2 = 4, and y = 16 − 32 + 21 = 5. Completing the square gives y = (x − 4)² + 5.
questions.calc: Graph it and tap the lowest point of the parabola: (4, 5).

questions.stem: In the equation <var>x</var><sup>2</sup> + 6<var>x</var> + <var>c</var> = 0, <var>c</var> is a constant. For what value of <var>c</var> does the equation have exactly one real solution?
questions.explain: One real solution means the discriminant is zero: 6² − 4c = 0, so c = 9. Then the equation is (x + 3)² = 0.
questions.calc: Graph y = x^2 + 6x + c with a slider for c. The parabola just touches the x-axis when c = 9.
